_comment_: No repository mode or routes: the Harness-deployed config/model-routing.lock.json policy (delegation.mode and routing) decides; the Harness-rendered host policy is only a fallback when that lock is absent (ADR-88, owner decision 1-A). Modes: force_codex preserves Codex-first behavior; force_claude forces Claude; select/obey_user honor an explicit requested backend; unrestricted honors any valid requested backend; per_project enables project-specific overrides. Routing/monitoring null or empty values preserve current behavior.
